profile.headline: Senior Principal Software Engineer at Oracle
profile.summary:
Oracle Ace, co-author of Oracle Applications DBA Field Guide and Oracle R12 Applications DBA Field Guide. I have over 20 years experience as an Oracle DBA with much of that time as an Oracle Applications DBA. My experience includes Oracle database versions 7 through 12c and E-Business Suite versions through 12. 

Specialties: Oracle Database Administration, E-Business Suite Administration, Oracle Database Performance

positions.title: Senior Oracle Performance Consultant
positions.description:
Work with a variety of customers both on-site and remotely to resolve challenging Oracle database performance problems. 

Projects included:
Performance evaluations of Oracle Database systems including Exadata, RAC, etc.
Identifying and resolving performance issues for web based or other online transactions, for large reports or data loads and issues following Database or Application upgrades.
Working with a variety of Oracle Database version including current releases.
Reviewing database workloads to recommend system changes.
Working with development teams to redesign applications to perform optimally and correct bugs affecting performance and functionality.
Providing recommendations for monitoring to proactively respond to issues.
Providing recommendations for performance tuning upgrade processes.
Providing recommendations for database features and operating system configurations.
Health checks and performance audits.
Assisting with marketing efforts by creating content and promoting the company's social media.
Participating in client scoping calls in order to create Statements of Work for engagements.
Educating customers about the optimization of Oracle-based systems.

positions.title: Program Director - EBS App Tech SIG
positions.description: Founding member of the EBS App Tech Special Interest Group in the OAUG. I served for 8 years as Program Director and Vice President of this group. In this position I attended numerous OAUG functions, presented material to user community, and attended SIG meetings.

positions.title: Oracle Apps DBA (Technical Architect)
positions.description:
Performed database administration tasks for Oracle 8i through 11gR2 instances running on AIX UNIX and SUSE Linux servers.
Supported multiple instances of Oracle E-Business Suite products, including the Human Resources and Payroll modules with Self-Service enabled for over 24,000 associates. The GL, AP, AR and FA financial related modules are used with iExpense and iProcurement enabled for online access.
Performed multiple database upgrades.
Performed multiple Oracle Applications upgrades.
Served as tech lead for Linux migration project to move application servers from AIX to Linux.
Served as tech lead for multiple load tests, directed DBA staff on monitoring the test, performed analysis of results, and created documentation for completed test.
Served as DBA tech lead for installation of Sabrix Tax system which interfaced with Oracle EBS system.
Experience with EMC Cloning technology and IBM Flash Copy technology.
Served as tech lead for moving instances from cold backups to online, hot backups.
Served as DBA tech lead for Disaster Recovery planning for E-Business Suite.
Served on department Technical Architecture review committee.
Developed jobs and events within Oracle Enterprise Manager to assist with database and application management.
Supported a mixed platform, multi-node, load balanced deployment of E-Business Suite using a hardware SSL solution.
Supported OID/SSO with E-Business Suite using a third-party SSO.
Developed and maintained UNIX shell scripts to assist with database and application management.
Acted as mentor for junior level DBAs.

positions.title: Oracle Database Administrator
positions.description:
Performed database administration tasks for Oracle 7.3.4 and 8i instances running on AIX UNIX and Windows NT servers.
Designed and implemented backup and recovery plans for Oracle databases.
Upgraded and managed Oracle Database servers and Oracle Web Application servers.
Developed SQL scripts and UNIX shell scripts to assist with database management.
Designed a multidimensional database in Oracle Express.
Developed Express programs to interact with data cube.
